at Dayu Ridge it could not be lifted
Senses.Note: All robe-and-bowl retellings and later presentation allusions belong to one case family; their repetition does not establish independent history.

Occurrences.Kwic: 金粟專使送法衣至，上堂，師云：「大庾嶺頭提不起，雞足山前成滯貨，山僧今日獲一披，如雲普覆華王座。大眾記取：三十年後切不可動著。何也？動著則禍生。」
Occurrences.AttributionNote: Source record (J/J26/J26nB177.xml). Recorded Sayings of Chan Master Poshan. Poshan is the direct utterer in 師云. Huiming is the implicit unable-to-lift performer in the inherited case; the robe and bowl are the omitted case objects.

Senses.Explanation: The phrase alludes to the Dayu Ridge case in which Huiming cannot lift the robe and bowl. When a Dharma robe arrives, Poshan invokes the Dayu Ridge inability to lift and contrasts it with his own receiving and wearing the robe. The omitted object comes from the inherited robe-and-bowl case; Poshan is the present direct speaker, while Huiming and Huineng remain embedded case figures.
